While `.SRCINFO` is not executable, it is part of the AUR package metadata and could theoretically be used to mislead about sources or checksums. However, in this case, all values appear legitimate and aligned with standard packaging practices. The file does not skip checksums, use mutable sources, or reference external scripts. Therefore, no evidence of supply chain tampering or malicious intent is found.
